prompt: In this anime style illustration, a bustling shipyard dock unfolds under a clear sky. On the far left, a woman in a yellow hard hat stands firmly, holding a clipboard with both hands. Next to her, a gray crane looms tall, its metal arm extended upward. In the center foreground, a man in blue overalls kneels on the wooden planks, inspecting a rusted anchor chain that lies coiled beside him. To his right, a small orange cat sits calmly on a stack of wooden crates, watching the scene with wide eyes. Behind the cat, a boy in a striped shirt points excitedly toward the water, his finger directed at a distant white sailboat. Near the boy, an elderly man in a beige coat looks at the pointing finger, his expression curious and engaged. A brown dog rests next to the elderly man, its head tilted as if listening to the conversation. On the far right, a young girl in a red dress runs past a large steel container, her hair flowing behind her. She is handing a shiny apple to a worker in green coveralls who leans against the container wall. The worker accepts the fruit with a smile, while a black seagull perches on top of the container above them, observing the exchange. There is no smoke rising from any machinery. There is no water visible in the immediate foreground.
